column3: With respect to the Capital Storage Portfolio Mortgage Loan (5.6%), the mortgaged property is comprised of 22 self-storage properties. The loan documents provide that, following the lockout period, the borrower may obtain the release of any individual property in connection with a bona fide sale of the of the release property to an unaffiliated third party, subject to certain conditions, including: (i) no event of default has occurred or be continuing, (ii) payment of a release price equal to the greatest of (A) 85% of the net sales proceeds from the property sale, (B) 110% of the allocated loan amount for the release property or (C) an amount sufficient to comply with related REMIC requirements, together with the applicable yield maintenance premium therefor; (iii) the post-release debt service coverage ratio of the remaining properties’ being no less than 1.30x; (iv) the post-release debt yield of the remaining properties’ being no less than 8.5%; and (v) an opinion of counsel that the partial release complies with REMIC requirements.
